name: 温馨亲子家庭装套装款
description: 亲子家庭装套图模版：白底挂拍、套装卖点、出行场景、包边细节与温馨收口

styleLock.backgroundSystem: seamless white #FFFFFF for the main packshot, solid sakura pink #F2919E and soft blush pink #F7C5CC for benefit, variant and closing shots, warm cream #F5EDE3 for lifestyle
styleLock.lightingSystem: bright soft studio lighting, front-left key with gentle fill, rounded soft shadows, cozy warm mood
styleLock.surfaceSystem: natural wooden hangers and light wood rack, matte neutral board #EFE9E4 for detail work
styleLock.iconSystem: soft-edge pink badge and capsule label shapes only, no complex icons
styleLock.presentationRules: stable garment scale, garments hung or laid flat, centered placement, no human faces
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent warm family-matching apparel visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of cloud white #FFFFFF, sakura pink #F2919E, soft blush pink #F7C5CC and charcoal text #3B3B3D; bright soft studio lighting with a front-left key, rounded gentle shadows and a cozy playful mood; modern rounded geometric sans-serif; simple soft-edge pink badge and capsule label shapes only, no complex icons; clean apparel photography with natural wooden hangers and soft fabric texture; stable garment scale and centered placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

shots.intent: 搜索列表一眼点击，干净合规的白底主图
shots.camera: straight-on eye-level view, garment on a natural wooden hanger, full garment visible and centered
shots.lighting: bright even high-key studio lighting, front-left key with soft fill, one soft contact shadow
shots.promptTemplate: Product photography of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The garment hangs on a natural wooden hanger, photographed straight-on at eye level, full garment visible and centered. Bright even high-key studio lighting with a front-left key and soft fill, one soft contact shadow grounding the hanger. Seamless pure white background #FFFFFF. The garment occupies 60-70% of the frame with no extra whitespace. 8K commercial apparel quality. Negative: no model, no recognizable child face, no props, no watermark, no fake logo, no extra text, no third-party character prints or trademark graphics, no colored background tint, no cut-off edges.

shots.intent: 一秒传达一家同款的家庭温馨感，建立核心卖点
shots.camera: slight 3/4 angle at eye level, parent garment and child garment grouped side by side
shots.lighting: soft front-left key light, rounded gentle shadows
shots.background: solid sakura pink #F2919E with a soft blush banner shape #F7C5CC across the top
shots.props: one soft-edge blush banner shape, no physical props
shots.promptTemplate: E-commerce benefit hero of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. The family-matching set grouped as a parent garment and a child garment side by side, shown at a slight 3/4 angle at eye level. Soft front-left key light with rounded gentle shadows. Solid sakura pink background #F2919E with a soft blush banner shape #F7C5CC across the top, generous negative space on the left 35% for copy. The set occupies 50-60% of the frame. Negative: no model faces, no recognizable child face, no invented fabric or efficacy claims, no dense body text, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character prints or trademark graphics, no props covering the garments.

shots.intent: 代入家庭出行前的整理场景，营造温馨生活感
shots.camera: documentary eye-level candid view of a light wooden clothing rack
shots.lighting: soft morning window light from the left around 5500K, gentle shadows
shots.background: warm cream wall #F5EDE3 with a light wood clothing rack
shots.props: a small potted green plant and a folded stack of clothes on a nearby stool, not covering the garments
shots.promptTemplate: Lifestyle scene of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Soft morning window light from the left around 5500K, gentle shadows. Warm cream wall #F5EDE3. shots.intent: 用包边与缝线微距证明做工细节
shots.camera: extreme close-up macro, clean side profile of the cuff edge
shots.lighting: skimming side light from the right revealing stitching and fabric texture, shallow depth of field with foreground sharp
shots.whitespace: minimal, the detail is the subject
shots.promptTemplate: Extreme close-up macro of {product}. {product_identity_lock}. {style_lock}. Tight zoom on the cuff binding and the round-collar seam, photographed from a clean side profile, the detail fills 55-60% of the frame. Skimming side light from the right revealing stitching and fabric texture, shallow depth of field with the foreground sharp. Neutral matte board background #EFE9E4, minimal whitespace as the detail is the subject. Negative: no blurry subject, no invented fabric composition or thread-count numbers, no hands, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character prints or trademark graphics.

shots.lighting: even high-key flat lighting with minimal shadow
shots.whitespace: even margins on all four sides around the flat lay

The full family set in two colorways, a light set and a dark set, laid flat and photographed from a top-down 90-degree overhead angle, directly from above, the two colorways clearly separated. Even high-key flat lighting with minimal shadow. Soft blush pink background #F7C5CC. The set occupies 35-40% of the frame with even margins on all four sides. Negative: no mixed lighting between colorways, no model, no recognizable child face, no overlapping garments, no extra text, no watermark, no fake logo, no third-party character prints or trademark graphics.

shots.lighting: soft punchy studio light from the front-left, gentle contact shadows

shots.props: one empty rounded CTA button placeholder and two empty label capsules left blank

The family set grouped at a slight 3/4 hero angle at eye level, centered, with one empty rounded CTA button placeholder and two empty label capsules left blank for post-editing copy. provenance.notes: 5屏事实：屏1粉色卡通云朵头图主打可爱温馨家庭装新款亲子装，下方为白底木衣架挂拍的男款/女款白色短袖T恤；屏2为成人尺码表（M-3XL，衣长胸围肩宽裤长臀围腰围脚口宽列），模特信息标注为成人身材穿L码，可选颜色为深色印花款，并有提示：妈妈/女童为背带裙、爸爸/男童为黑色裤子；屏3为工艺卖点环绕图（袖口包边、经典圆领、精美印花、实用口袋、条纹裤子）加透气面料宣传段落；屏4为三步蒸汽演示空图框与大图占位；屏5为品牌字标与粉色空框。品类判定：主品为亲子家庭装套装（成人T恤+儿童下装/背带裙同款组合），尺码为成人M-3XL量级且为外穿T恤与下装组合，属母婴/童装（外穿）而非内衣家居服/儿童内衣；亲子装由儿童需求驱动，归母婴/童装。已剥离：品牌字标与英文标语、原文案原句、胸前具体印花图案（只保留矩形图位结构描述，图案交给 product_identity_lock）、尺码表全部实测数值（换空白占位）、面料成分与透气功效断言、蒸汽测试结论；儿童相关画面全部不出现可辨识童模面容，仅用服装挂拍/平铺呈现。
